title: Remove final C6 harness parameter and automatic-variable collisions
goal: Remove two fail-closed harness collisions without changing cases, detector behavior, reviewed capabilities or timeouts.
acceptanceCriteria: The matrix wrapper never specifies SolutionLockPath or AssemblyLockPath more than once on an intercepted producer command.
The control runner completes root controls without assigning PowerShell's read-only Host automatic variable.
Fresh Windows and Linux matrices prove 191/191 equal semantics and controls prove 42 lock plus 180 capability cases.
The repeated Linux timeout is addressed only by execution-root isolation, with no timeout or policy broadening.
Published 1.1.3 bytes, detectors, producers, cases, reviewed capabilities and governance remain unchanged.
